name: Gentle Gel Cleanser
summary: A clear, low-foam gel cleanser that removes makeup and sunscreen without a tight feel.
description: This everyday gel cleanser lifts away makeup, sunscreen and excess oil with a soft, low-foam lather. Aloe leaf juice and glycerin keep skin comfortable after rinsing, so it suits morning and evening use. The clear base takes color and fragrance well, making it an easy first product for a new line.
highlights: Clear base accepts color and fragrance
usage: Massage a pea-sized amount onto damp skin for 30 seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water. Use morning and evening.

composition.label: Ingredients
composition.text: Water, Sodium Cocoyl Glycinate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Sodium Chloride, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.

image.alt: Illustration of a clear gel cleanser in a pump bottle

name: Cream Cleansing Milk
summary: A non-foaming cleansing milk with oat and sunflower oil for dry, sensitive skin.
description: A silky, non-foaming cleanser that melts away the day without stripping. Colloidal oat and sunflower seed oil cushion the skin while a gentle emulsifier rinses clean or tissues off. Spa and mature-skin brands use it as the comfort step in a two-step evening routine.
highlights: Popular with spa and mature-skin lines
usage: Smooth over dry skin, massage gently, then rinse or remove with a warm cloth.

name: Clarifying BHA Cleanser
summary: A 2% salicylic acid foaming cleanser for oily and blemish-prone skin.
description: A foaming gel built around 2% salicylic acid to clear excess oil from pores, balanced with niacinamide and green tea to keep skin calm. It is a strong anchor product for acne-focused brands. Label copy must follow US rules for acne products, and our team can share the required directions.
usage: Use once daily at first, building to twice daily. Lather on damp skin for 30–60 seconds and rinse.

composition.label: Ingredients
composition.text: Water, Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Salicylic Acid, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Sodium Hydroxide, Phenoxyethanol.

highlights: Ships in amber or opaque packaging

specs.label: Best for
specs.value: All skin types, especially dull skin
